title: NotesLoomCastKitSurrealIntegrationClosureGate
clause: Prove complete Notes, Loom and real CKC/Atelier connectivity on SurrealDB with privacy, restart, recovery and native UI evidence.

current_source_discovery: Independently inspect exact stable-main records, APIs, UI, tests, diagnostics and manuals delivered by MT-393 through MT-397.
Construct a representative multi-project workflow using real Notes, CKC/Atelier and brokered assets, not synthetic Loom-only entities.
stop_conditions: Any integration claim relies on synthetic blocks, mocks, UI labels or pre-merge code.
Any canonical authority, cross-project grant or recovery verdict is ambiguous.

scope.summary: Independent product closure for the connected IDE/creative substrate: real Notes and CKC/Atelier resources are linked through Loom, reused across authorized projects, visible in graph/search/views, and recoverable from SurrealDB without duplicate authority.
forbidden_paths: Synthetic CKC/Loom-only entity as integration proof
Self-authored success record as sole proof
acceptance_criteria: A real CKC character, character-sheet version, moodboard and brokered image are created through their owning product APIs, projected into Loom, linked/embedded in a canonical Note and independently reread from SurrealDB.
Backlinks, graph, search, canvas/collection views and open-in-owner navigation traverse the real typed relations in both directions without duplicated mutable source data.
A second authorized project reuses explicitly shared resources while an ungranted account/project sees no content, counts, facets, thumbnails, relation degree or source-type metadata.

Update, delete, restore, revoke, crash, restart, stale projection, broken asset and failed promotion scenarios converge through EventLedger/outbox and MT-391 repair with canonical Surreal reread proof.
Native Notes, Loom and CKC workflows pass Argus navigation, drag/drop plus keyboard equivalent, responsive layout, accessibility, renderer-error and failure-state checks.

Authority proof confirms SurrealDB is the sole main database; CKC owns character domain, Notes/RichDocument owns editable note content, Loom owns typed connectivity/projections, and future Tailor/Studio remain fixture-only.
proof_targets: Run complete real-Surreal Notes-Loom-CKC multi-project E2E from fresh database through restart, revoke and repair.
Run independent authority, source-identity, forbidden-dependency and synthetic-fixture tripwires.
Run authenticated record-user privacy matrix, full Argus workflow and no-context UserManual operation/recovery test.

target_entries: Connected workflows > Notes, Loom and CastKit

same_project_private_resource_cases: Private Notes and CKC resources remain hidden from another member throughout the full linked workflow.
cross_account_negative_cases: All forged note, CKC, projection, relation, cursor, payload and repair selectors fail closed.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Every backlink, graph path, search result, preview, view item, export, event and diagnostic preserves source-scope intersection.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Concurrent revoke/context switch invalidates open editors, media, graph, search, embeds, payloads and repair controls.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Remote/crawler/model identities never inherit local grants or bypass quarantine.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: complete connected workflow, privacy, failure, repair and replay event coverage
cross-module identity, projection, link, search, asset and repair health

risk_if_missed: Handshake can claim connected modules while only synthetic or happy-path seams work, undermining its core IDE and creative-tool architecture.

risks: Synthetic fixtures substitute for real CKC records.
Restart leaves stale links or previews.
Future fixture publishers leak into product scope.
minimum_controls: Source scan proving Tailor/Studio fixture-only boundary.

sources: Accepted MT-391 and MT-393 through MT-397 evidence
Stable merged WP-KERNEL-012 and WP-CKC product APIs
research_provenance.selected_approach: Independent real-source, multi-project, failure-tested closure of Notes-Loom-CKC connectivity on sole-authority SurrealDB.
